introduction: Hello! I am Mark John B. Mesa, a second-year Information Technology student who enjoys learning about computers, networking, and new technologies. I want to improve my skills and gain more knowledge in the IT field.
biography: I am a second-year BSIT student at Nueva Vizcaya State University. I am interested in computer networking, network management, and cybersecurity. As a student, I continue to learn new things and improve my technical skills through school activities and personal practice.
careerGoal: My goal is to become a Network Administrator or Network Security Specialist. I want to learn how to manage computer networks, fix network problems, and protect systems from security threats.
interests: My interests include computer networking, network security, troubleshooting, website development, and learning new technologies.
educationDescription: I am currently taking Bachelor of Science in Information Technology at Nueva Vizcaya State University. My major is Network Management and Security, where I want to develop my knowledge of computer networks and network protection.
